rules.name: PowerShell Suspicious Execution
rules.description: Detect encoded PowerShell, -bypass, hidden window, and download cradle patterns
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 and Process in ("powershell.exe", "cmd.exe") and (CommandLine contains "-enc" or CommandLine contains "base64") | summarize count() by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
